# JS codegen for map<K,V>: literal, index, and method dispatch via HTML platform.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# Map literal is emitted as new Map([[k, v], ...]).
grep 'new Map\(' out/index.html
grep '"alice", 10' out/index.html
grep '"bob", 20' out/index.html

# map.length() dispatches to JS Map .size property.
grep '\.size' out/index.html

# map.get() dispatches to .has()/.get() ternary.
grep '\.has\(' out/index.html
grep '\.get\(' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"

output { none { html } }

component main {
    var scores map<string, int> = {alice = 10, bob = 20}
    var size = 0
    button(text="count", @click {
        size = scores.length()
    })
    button(text="check", @click {
        size = scores.get("alice", 0)
    })
    text(value=string(size))
}
